ChannelArn.description:
ARN identifier of the channel.
Example: arn:aws:chatbot::123456789012:chat-configuration/slack-channel/security-ops
ChannelArn.markdownDescription:
ARN identifier of the channel.
Example: arn:aws:chatbot::123456789012:chat-configuration/slack-channel/security-ops

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Pattern: ^arn:[a-z-]{3,10}:(chatbot|consoleapp|notifications-contacts):[a-zA-Z0-9-]*:[0-9]{12}:[a-zA-Z0-9-_.@]+/[a-zA-Z0-9/_.@:-]+$  
Update requires: Replacement

ManagedNotificationConfigurationArn.description:
ARN identifier of the Managed Notification.
Example: arn:aws:notifications::381491923782:managed-notification-configuration/category/AWS-Health/sub-category/Billing
ManagedNotificationConfigurationArn.markdownDescription:
ARN identifier of the Managed Notification.
Example: arn:aws:notifications::381491923782:managed-notification-configuration/category/AWS-Health/sub-category/Billing

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Pattern: ^arn:[a-z-]{3,10}:notifications::([0-9]{12}|):managed-notification-configuration/category/[a-zA-Z0-9\-]{3,64}/sub-category/[a-zA-Z0-9\-]{3,64}$  
Update requires: Replacement

IsSensitiveEventsSubscribed.description: Whether the channel association is subscribed to sensitive events. Access to sensitive events is gated by the SubscribeSensitiveEvents virtual IAM action.
IsSensitiveEventsSubscribed.markdownDescription:
Whether the channel association is subscribed to sensitive events. Access to sensitive events is gated by the SubscribeSensitiveEvents virtual IAM action.

---

Required: No  
Type: Boolean  
Update requires: No interruption
